brief:
Israeli far-right politician Itamar Ben-Gvir appears poised for electoral gains as young voters shift toward his political positions, Al-Monitor reported. Ben-Gvir has made inflammatory statements, including celebrating his 50th birthday with a cake decorated with a noose and stating plans to surround jailed Palestinians with crocodiles.

The shift reflects broader political movement among younger Israeli voters toward more hardline positions on Palestinian affairs and security matters.
dek: By Emily Rose and Hannah Confino TEL AVIV, Oct 20 (Reuters) - He celebrated his 50th birthday with a cake decorated with a noose. He says he plans to surround jailed Palestinians with crocodiles.
title: Ben-Gvir positioned to gain ground with Israeli youth voters
